effect: A blockaded country was told it grows everything it eats, because the sentence shows whenever no supplier is delivering. The new wording is true in both cases and points to the figure that tells them apart. The original fix also chose by self-sufficiency; wording changes cannot do that. English and French only; the other 16 languages keep the old text.
